description: This file defines asynchronous database operations related to roles, including functions for retrieving a role by id, listing roles with optional filtering, and creating new roles within a SQLAlchemy ORM context.

methods.name: Optional[Role] get_role_by_id(session: AsyncSession, role_id: str)
methods.description: Asynchronously fetches a role by its ID, returning None if not found.

methods.name: List[Role] list_roles(session: AsyncSession, q: Optional[str] = None)
methods.description: Asynchronously retrieves a list of roles, optionally filtered by a search query applied to name or description.

methods.name: Role create_role(session: AsyncSession, payload: RoleCreate)
methods.description: Asynchronously creates a new role in the database, raising ValueError if a role with the same ID already exists.
